verdict.rationale: Asana documents a REST API with an official OpenAPI spec (GitHub repo), client SDKs, and a dedicated deprecations page describing communication of upcoming changes, Asana-Change response headers, and an opt-in/opt-out testing period via Asana-Enable/Asana-Disable headers plus a migration plan — a clear versioned deprecation policy. missing for 10: no explicit semantic-version numbering scheme shown, and no independent/community corroboration of the deprecation process actually being followed in practice.
